findings.observed: Selected claim items are grouped under one field fact; aggregate verification uses verified_any and item values discard trust state.
findings.current_incident: No mixed field occurs in the current trio under the existing file-only corroborator, but recognizing ignored source_file evidence immediately creates a mixed 3D install field that launders two unverified items.
findings.closure: Per-item trust is retained and a mixed field cannot enter accepted composition as wholly verified.

findings.observed: Non-license corroboration checks that an evidence file exists, not that a symbol, line, implementation, or polarity supports the claim.
findings.current_incident: 3D FBX and Barcode PDF positive/negative claims demonstrate conflicting selection; COLLADA demonstrates internal implementation is not public reachability. NurbsSurface.to_mesh is a separate API-rendering defect: an accepted public-signature fact is upgraded into capability prose although the body is a stub.
findings.closure: Claim evidence resolves against the pinned source tree, positive/negative conflicts are explicit, and public reachability is distinct from internal symbol existence.

findings.observed: Trio API claims are rejected as covered while structured API detection produces no usable trio fact because schema and reachability variants are mishandled.
findings.current_incident: 3,398 API claims are rejected across 3D, Note, and Barcode while imported public-surface output is empty.
findings.closure: Actual API schema variants normalize to non-empty canonical facts, and claims are suppressed only when equivalent structured coverage exists.

findings.observed: Knowledge-application evidence is written before rendering and scans document-plan operation fact IDs only; final candidate provenance is not joined.
findings.current_incident: Current production evidence necessarily has empty influenced sections and rendered spans; no post-feature trio artifact proves imported facts changed candidate bytes.
findings.closure: A candidate-hash-bound final report joins plan operations and candidate-content provenance and accounts for every selected item.

findings.observed: Reconciliation errors are persisted as diagnostic error objects and do not block candidate promotion; relocation and omission ownership are incomplete.
findings.current_incident: The real relocation fixture is xfailed and verified-template full-source compilation can overlap fine-grained placements.
findings.closure: All source bytes and content units have causal dispositions, the real fixture passes, and any reconciliation error blocks promotion.

findings.observed: Optimizer vendors 89 of 103 canonical Aspose checks; only 11 canonical functions currently block, and applicable hard check skips/errors fail open.
findings.current_incident: Fourteen canonical checks are missing; coverage artifacts can themselves contain an error without blocking acceptance.
findings.closure: All 103 checks are inventoried/classified, every applicable hard check returns pass/fail, and skip/error blocks promotion.

findings.observed: Merged Qwen review is capped at 4,000 completion tokens and malformed/truncated top-level output does not invoke the existing separated review clients.
findings.current_incident: Committed status contains an exact finish_reason=length truncated-JSON system failure.
findings.closure: Merged transport/parse/schema failure falls back to bounded separated blind and factual review; all material claim groups receive dispositions.

findings.observed: Current no-op and candidate comparisons largely use already-refreshed READMEs; 3D imported knowledge is post-refresh and partly README-derived.
findings.current_incident: Historical July candidates were layout wrappers with broken placeholders and all three failed their own review; Note fabricated Maven/JDK instructions.
findings.closure: 3D, Note, and Barcode generate from pinned pre-refresh SHAs without refreshed README leakage, then pass factual, reconciliation, check, independent-review, and no-op gates.

findings.observed: PSD/Python and PSD/.NET are in the 33-entry registry but absent from the 31 imported bundles and supplied Aspose candidate/run evidence.
findings.current_incident: Optimizer currently blocks PSD/Python for missing evidence; Aspose README-only handling is not proven by the supplied package.
findings.closure: Pending PSD evidence is reconciled and a generic README-only profile produces useful prose with explicit not-applicable code surfaces and no fabricated implementation claims.

findings.observed: declared_python_runtime_dependencies and declared_python_build_dependencies return a bare empty list for setup.py/setup.cfg-only repositories, with no not-applicable or parse state.
findings.current_incident: The result is coincidentally correct for current 3D because install_requires is empty, but the behavior is a systemic silent-zero risk for other legacy Python repositories.
findings.closure: All Python manifest shapes either yield parsed runtime/build dependencies or an explicit typed non-applicability/error; a setup.py fixture with non-empty install_requires cannot return silent empty.

findings.observed: Hosted workflow uses an observation profile without local fact verification, independent review, or restored local evidence and targets a suspended legacy status.
findings.current_incident: A green hosted run cannot establish current Gate A or reconstruct a zero-call no-op across workflow runs.
findings.closure: The existing hosted read-only path executes verified facts/review/evidence, restores content-addressed bundles, follows platform priority, and proves current NO_OP_PROVEN with zero target writes.
